text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(For this upcoming trip, I'd prefer to arrive on-site with time to spare.
I want to avoid rushing and ensure we approach it in peak condition.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Before I discuss this with Trainer, maybe I should consult the Expedition Committee first.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me.
I'd like to consult with you regarding the expedition—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: CHESTOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: At this moment, the field will be ruled by cats! Can thou endure an ocean of paw pads running wild in all directions?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hah! Bringing a cat to a dog game...?
Interesting! Challenge accepted!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Wait, what even is a 'dog game'!?
I've seen it heaps of times,
but the rules are still a total mystery!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(...No good. If I call them out on this,
I won't be able to stop...)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh! It's Lara!
What's up with that face? You look like a carp begging for food.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah! Play with me too,
the dog game! I'll let ya borrow
my Siberian Husky!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
No, it's the Shiba Inu.
Win rate's 30%, but when it hits, it's a one-hit KO.
――Wanna bet?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
One... *ahem*!
No, well, you see...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Stop it, both of you!
Can't you see you're putting Lara-san in a bind?!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Are you alright, Miss Lala?
It looked like you were coughing?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ah... No, not at all, Fenomeno-san.
Thank you for your concern.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(I just had a bunch of comebacks
stuck in my throat, that's all...)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, Lara. Here's a souvenir for you.
Apparently, these candies are made from the nectar of a rare flower.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh... thank you very much.
Are you sure it's alright?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...
Big Sis is only doing it out of kindness, after all.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes, by the way.
I recently obtained a magazine like this.
Lala-san... would you perhaps be interested?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Ah, I've been wanting to read that for ages!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Could it be, Journey-san, that you remembered what we talked about before?)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I can lend it to you if you'd like.
Also, I'll prepare some tea right now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was scheduled to have a meeting with
Lucky Lilac, but she hadn't shown up.
When I went to check on her, I found her in the Expedition Support Committee room—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The "Deep-Sea Creature That Suits Lala Championship"~♪
A Coelacanth!? Or maybe a Giant Squid!?
What's your answer, Mame-chin!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, what kind of prompt is that?!
Surely you have better ones! Like... something more impactful!!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
My vote goes to the anglerfish.
Waiting silently until the prey comes along—
that kind of competitive style suits me well.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Um... to have you put so much thought into it for me makes me kind of embarrassed...
choice_data_list: (Wow, I'm being totally doted on here.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? Trainer-san?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
—Oh shoot, the meeting!!
I'm so sorry, Trainer!!
choice_data_list: It's fine, don't worry about it

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I apologize.
It seems I've kept you here for too long.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: No, thank you! I just got totally carried away talking.
choice_data_list: I wonder if they'll be back soon.
Why don't you stay and play with everyone today?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes. But before that...
About what I wanted to discuss with you today—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Thank you for today.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
No, no, please come again.
You're always welcome here.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Everyone really treats me so well, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
It's so cozy here, I'll need to watch myself next time.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
――……
Lara was here, wasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait, are you sure it's alright?
choice_data_list: Just for today, it'll be fine!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Then it's settled! Listen up, Lala!
From this moment on, life is game time!
I make the rules! Explanations come later!"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I'd like a refill on tea.
You'll have some too, Lala-san?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, yes.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
――……
Lara was here, wasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
That's right, Orfe.
Fufu... today was a truly profound time as well.
Right, Sis?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. When those flowers are in full bloom,
I certainly wouldn't want to miss it.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.
